title: COMBO - C-5 Main Landing Gear Stands
description: This is a one time supply purchase of C-5 Main Landing Gear Stands. The Contractor shall supply all parts, materials, and transport necessary to deliver four (4) C-5 Main Landing Gear Stands. The equipment must provide maintenance access to the C-5 main landing gear in support of the 402d Aircraft Maintenance Group AMXG) at Robins Air Force Base (AFB), Georgia. Contractor shall provide: one (1) hardcopy and one (1) electronic copy of operation and maintenance manuals on all equipment delivered within seven (7) calendar days after inspection/acceptance of equipment. The manual shall include technical information, specifications, operational instructions, drawings, schematics, equipment maintenance instructions, and/or any other applicable information such as a recommended spare parts list. All copies shall be legible and written in English. (CDRL A001 DI-TMSS-80527B Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) Manuals and Associated Supplemental Data)

title: New Car Assessment Program (NCAP) Pedestrian Impact Testing
description: NHTSA's New Car Assessment Program (NCAP) requires pedestrian protection impact testing on production motor vehicles. The Contractor(s) shall perform test-procedure evaluation; impactor qualification (headform, Flexible Pedestrian Legform Impactor (Flex-PLI), and upper legform); and pedestrian headform, Flex-PLI, and upper-legform tests on assigned vehicle models, in accordance with the NCAP Crashworthiness Pedestrian Protection Test Procedure, together with related qualification, reporting, and optional cyclist/aPLI testing. The Government intends to make multiple awards and to issue firm-fixed-price task/delivery orders for testing as vehicle models are assigned. valuation: Award will be made on a best-value tradeoff basis considering the following technical factors � (1) Technical Plan, Quality Assurance Management Plan, and Test Procedures; (2) Facilities and Equipment; (3) Organization and Personnel Qualifications; and (4) Past Performance and Prior Experience - and price. The technical factors, combined, are more important than price. Please see the attached for the full solitcitation and all support documents.

title: Mass Properties Measuring Instruments Calibration Services
description: SOURCES SOUGHT TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION INTRODUCTION The United States Army Yuma Proving Ground (USAYPG) is issuing this sources sought notice as a means of conducting market research to identify parties having an interest in and the resources to support the requirement for Mass Properties Measuring Instruments Calibration Services. The intention is to procure these services on a competitive basis. BASED ON THE RESPONSES TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT NOTICE/MARKET RESEARCH, THIS REQUIREMENT MAY BE SET-ASIDE FOR SMALL BUSINESSES (IN FULL OR IN PART) OR PROCURED THROUGH FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION. All Small Business Set-Aside categories will be considered. Telephone inquiries will not be accepted or acknowledged, and no feedback or evaluations will be provided to companies regarding their submissions. Place of Performance: Yuma Proving Ground DISCLAIMER �THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY. THIS IS NOT A �REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (RFP)� or Request for Quote (RFQ). IT DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SOLICITATION OR A COMMITMENT BY THE GOVERNMENT. Responses do not constitute offers, and the government is not obligated to award a contract. NO FUNDS ARE AVAILABLE TO PAY FOR PREPARATION or submittal OF RESPONSES. the government is not committed or obligated to pay for the information provided, and no basis for claims against the Government shall arise as a result of a response to this Sources Sought INFORMATION SUBMITTED BY RESPONDENTS TO THIS SOURCES SOUGHT IS STRICTLY VOLUNTARY. RESPPONSES WILL NOT BE RETURNED TO THE RESPONDER. NOT RESPONDING TO THIS NOTICE DOES NOT PRECLUDE PARTICIPATION IN ANY FUTURE PROCURMENT ACTION. IT IS THE RESPONSIBILITY OF POTENTIAL OFFERORS TO MONITOR THE GPE FOR ADDITIONAL INFORMMATION PERTAINING TO THIS REQUIREMENT.� PROGRAM BACKGROUND Historically, the U.S. Army Yuma Proving Ground (YPG) utilizes unique precision mass property measurements on artillery and mortar ammunition. Annual calibration services are required in order to maintain traceability to the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). NIST is the government agency that promotes and maintains measurement standards and is the agency referenced throughout the industry for maintaining traceability. This contract covers on-site repair and annual preventative (PM) services (Parts, Labor, and Travel) for the instruments listed in section 1.3 of the attached PWS at U.S. Army Yuma Proving Ground (YPG), Yuma, Arizona. REQUIRED CAPABILITIES The contractor shall provide calibration services for eight (8) mass property measurement instruments (found in Table 1 of the attached PWS). Calibration must be traceable through NIST and the systems must be tested and compared to the original factory specifications. All services should be conducted in alignment with requirements defined in Part 5 of this PWS. Further detail is provided in the draft Performance Work Statement (PWS) attached to this announcement (Attachment 1_20260825_Draft Mass Properties Measuring Instruments Calibration Service PWS). If your organization has the potential capacity to perform these contract services, please provide the following information: 1) Organization name, address, email address, Web site address, telephone number, and size and type of ownership for the organization; 2) Tailored capability statements addressing the particulars of this effort, with appropriate documentation supporting claims of organizational and staff capability. If significant subcontracting or teaming is anticipated in order to deliver technical capability, organizations should address the administrative and management structure of such arrangements; and The Government will evaluate market information to ascertain potential market capacity to: 1) Provide services consistent, in scope and scale, with those described in this notice and otherwise anticipated; 2) Secure and apply the full range of corporate financial, human capital, and technical resources required to successfully perform similar requirements; and 3) implement a successful project management plan including: compliance with program schedules; cost containment; performance tracking; retention of key personnel, hiring plan to fill gaps and performance risk mitigation. ELIGIBILITY The applicable NAICS code for this requirement is 541380 with a Small Business Size Standard of $19.0 mil. The Product Service Code is J066 Maint/Repair/Rebuild of Equipment � Instruments and Laboratory Equipment. Businesses of all sizes are encouraged to respond; however, each respondent must clearly identify their business size in their capabilities statement. ADDITIONAL INFORMATION AND SUBMISSION DETAILS (CAPABILITIES STATEMENT) Interested parties are requested to submit a capabilities statement of no more than 10 pages in length using 10-point Times New Roman font of not less than 10 pitch. This documentation must address at a minimum the following items: What type of work has your company performed in the past in support of the same or similar requirement? Can or has your company managed a task of this nature? If so, please provide details. Can or has your company managed a team of subcontractors before? If so, provide details. What specific technical skills does your company possess which ensure capability to perform the tasks? Please note that under a Small-Business Set-Aside, in accordance with FAR 52.219-14, the small business prime must perform at least 50% of the work themselves in terms of the cost of performance. Provide an explanation of your company�s ability to perform at least 50% of the tasking described in this PBSOW for the base period as well as the option periods. Provide a statement including current small/large business status and company profile to include number of employees, annual revenue history, office locations, UEI number, etc. Respondents to this notice also must indicate whether they quality as a Small, Small Disadvantaged, Women-Owned, HUBZone, or Service Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business Concern. The proposed contract is subject to include tasking that would be accomplished by labor categories that are subject to the Service Contract Act or a collective bargaining agreement. Upon evaluation of the capability statements, if it is determined that this requirement will be an unrestricted competition, the Government intends to evaluate the Small-Business responses and conduct further market research to identify a subcontracting goal. The deadline for response to this request is no later than 14:00 Mountain Daylight Time (MDT), 25 September 2026. All response under this sources sought notice to include any capabilities statement must be e-mailed to Kristen Long (Contract Specialist) kristen.m.long6.civ@army.mil in either Microsoft Word or Portable Document Format (PDF). All data received in response to this Sources Sought that is marked or designated as corporate or proprietary will be fully protected from any release outside the Government. No phone calls will be accepted All questions must be submitted to the contract specialist identified above. The Government is not committed nor obligated to pay for the information provided, and no basis for claims against the Government shall arise as a result of a response to this sources sought notice.

title: Pre-Solicitation Notice Residential Reentry and Home Confinement Services Located within the County Limits of Berkeley County, West Virginia.
description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons is seeking providers for Residential Reentry Center (RRC) beds and Home Confinement services for male and female federal offenders in Berkeley County, West Virginia. Home Confinement placements must be within a 100?mile radius of the facility. Both RRC and Home Confinement services must follow the Federal Bureau of Prisons� Residential Reentry Center, March 2022 Statement of Work. Home Confinement requirements are defined in Chapter 10, with additional requirements noted throughout the SOW. This will be an indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity type contract with firm fixed unit prices for all line items. The RRC requirement will consist of an estimated maximum of 40 beds in which 32 beds will be designated for males and 8 beds designated for females for the One-year Base Period and each of the Four One-year Option Periods The Home Confinement requirement will consist of an estimated maximum of 20 placements to include both males and females for the One-year Base Period and each of the Four One-year Option Periods. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC and HC) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. The The Government reserves the right to potentially make an award which is deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. The Solicitation (RFP) will be available after October 1, 2026, exclusively on www.sam.gov. No hard copies will be provided. All updates will also be posted on this site, and interested parties are responsible for monitoring it for the latest information. The estimated closing date will be 60 days after the RFP is issued. All responsible sources may submit proposals. No collect calls will be accepted, and the agency will not accept telephone or written requests for the solicitation. Any questions regarding the pre-solicitation notice can be addressed to Rachel Brown at r16brown@bop.gov by 2:00PM MST on Friday, September 25, 2026.

title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source 60-ton Crane Repair
description: This requirement is for 60-ton Grove crane repair services for the 819th Red Horse Squadron (RHS) at Malmstrom Air Force Base. Contractor must meet OEM specifications as identified in Technical Order 36-1-191. This asset currently has a hydraulic leak that requires major drive-train disassembly and replacement of a 5 port hydraulic swivel manifold assembly. Also, several other items (wire rope, o-rings, fill cap with breather, element, lock pin, seal kit, slip ring assembly) need to be replaced in order for the crane to be certified as fully functional. Due to the hydraulic leak, the asset can not be driven and therefor needs to be transported to the maintenance shop where it will be repaired. There is currently no trailer in inventory large enough to move the 60-ton crane. This requirement will be solicited as a sole-source action to MGX Equipement Services as they are the only known authorized dealer in the state of Montana that has the capabilities to perform the complex repairs. The contractor shall perform all tasks in accordance with the saliant characteristics document and comply with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations.

description: 24 AUG 2026 This notice is being updated to provide additional questions/answers as received by the USG and to issue the attached RFP Amendment 01. Questions from Offerors: 1. Are CMMC requirements required of subcontractors? Per DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(1) (ii) prime contractors are to Consult 32 CFR 170.23 related to the flowdown of the CMMC requirements, and flow down the correct CMMC level to subcontracts and other contractual instruments Per DFARS 252.204-7021(d)(4) Prime contractors are to Ensure all subcontractors and suppliers complete prior to subcontract award, and maintain on an annual basis, an affirmation, by the affirming official (see 32 CFR 170.4), of continuous compliance with the requirements associated with the CMMC level required for the subcontract or other contractual instrument for each of the subcontractor information systems that process, store, or transmit FCI or CUI and that are used in performance of the subcontract Per CFR 107.23 Application to subcontractors (a) CMMC requirements apply to prime contractors and subcontractors throughout the supply chain at all tiers that will process, store, or transmit any FCI or CUI on contractor information systems in the performance of the DoD contract or subcontract. Prime contractors shall comply and shall require subcontractors to comply with and to flow down CMMC requirements, such that compliance will be required throughout the supply chain at all tiers with the applicable CMMC level and assessment type for each subcontract as follows: (1) If a subcontractor will only process, store, or transmit FCI (and not CUI) in performance of the subcontract, then a CMMC Status of Level 1 (Self) is required for the subcontractor. (2) If a subcontractor will process, store, or transmit CUI in performance of the subcontract, then a CMMC Status of Level 2 (Self) is the minimum requirement for the subcontractor. (3) If a subcontractor will process, store, or transmit CUI in performance of the subcontract and the associated prime contract has a requirement for a CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO), then the CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO) is the minimum requirement for the subcontractor. (4) If a subcontractor will process, store, or transmit CUI in performance of the subcontract and the associated prime contract has a requirement for the CMMC Status of Level 3 (DIBCAC), then the CMMC Status of Level 2 (C3PAO) is the minimum requirement for the subcontractor. 2. Can the Government First Article Test Requirements be waived? Yes. Information regarding First Article Test Requirements waivers are provided on Block 11 of the Form 260 attachment to the RFP. In accordance with Block 11, paragraph c., offerors who have previously furnished production quantities of the same or similar articles to the Air Force, provided articles thus furnished, have exhibited satisfactory performance in the opinion of the Air Force; provided not more than 36 months have elapsed since completion of the contract. Under conditions stated in paragraph c., the cognizant engineering activity will decide whether or not the item has exhibited satisfactory performance in service and prepare and retain supporting documentation to fully justify this decision. The following information must be provided for the previously supplied article: Procuring Office, Contract Number, Date of Contract, and Specification Number and Revision. 3. If the First Article Test requirements are waived, will the applicable CDRLs be removed? Yes. Any CDRL applicable to First Article requirements will be removed for offerors who qualify for GFAT waiver. Item Description: NSN: 1005-01-190-9802 P/N: 209F953 The Transfer Unit Mechanical Housing NSN 1005-01-190-9802, P/N 209F953 is the transfer unit attached to the M61A1 gun and is gear-driven by the gun. The transfer unit assembly is attached to the gun feeder. Its function is to transfer live rounds from feed chute to the feeder assembly, and to transfer empty cases from the unload drive assembly into conveyor elements in the return chute. Gear-driven sprocket assemblies and guides within the transfer unit maintain positive control of the rounds and conveyor elements passing through the transfer unit. The transfer unit removes rounds from the conveyor, places the rounds into the extractor lip of the gun breech bolts, receives expended cases and unfired rounds from the gun breech bolts, and places them in the conveyor. title: Y--Rehabilitation of Water and Wastewater System
description: This construction project consists of replacing and rehabilitating aging water, wastewater, electrical, mechanical, and SCADA infrastructure at Curecanti National Recreation Area, primarily at the Elk Creek and Lake Fork areas, with additional SCADA improvements at Iola. The work includes new and replacement utility piping, lift station improvements, septic and lagoon system work, generator connections, controls/telemetry upgrades, and associated site restoration, pavement repair, and utility coordination.

title: Perforated Window Film
description: This contract is in support of the United States Marine Corps Recruiting Command (MCRC) Branding Program for each of the six (6) Marine Corps Districts (MCD), which are located throughout the United States, overseas and its territories. The use of branded locations, emphasizing the approved Marine Corps colors, symbols, themes, furnishings, and lighting effects will help distinguish Marine Corps recruiting offices from recruiting offices of other Armed Services, providing a distinct recruiting advantage vis-a-vis other Services. The appearance of the branded offices leaves a positive impression not just with prospects, but their parents and other influencers as well. MCRC is taking steps to improve physical security of recruiting facilities. MCRC intends to utilize perforated window film on the glass surfaces of storefront recruiting facilities in order to provide concealment, more specifically, protection from observation. It is necessary to have a means of obscuring the view of Marine recruiting station from the outside as a force protection measure. It is also necessary that, where practical, the Marines maintain visibility of the area outside of their office in order to maintain their situational awareness. This will provide them with the possibility of early warning, if a potential aggressor is approaching the office or preparing to commit some type of hostile or unlawful act, outside the office. Perforated window film will allow for MCRC Branding Program success, while providing increased security for recruiting personnel and individuals visiting recruiting offices. As a part of this requirement, the current storefront glass graphics will be removed, and new perforated window film will be installed to span the entire glass window/door surface. Perforated window film will be installed on existing facilities that have no storefront graphics. Additionally, perforated film will be replaced on existing facilities as required.

title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source 60-ton Crane Repair
description: This requirement is for 60-ton Grove crane repair services for the 819th Red Horse Squadron (RHS) at Malmstrom Air Force Base. Contractor must meet OEM specifications as identified in Technical Order 36-1-191. This asset currently has a hydraulic leak that requires major drive-train disassembly and replacement of a 5 port hydraulic swivel manifold assembly. Also, several other items (wire rope, o-rings, fill cap with breather, element, lock pin, seal kit, slip ring assembly) need to be replaced in order for the crane to be certified as fully functional. Due to the hydraulic leak, the asset can not be driven and therefor needs to be transported to the maintenance shop where it will be repaired. There is currently no trailer in inventory large enough to move the 60-ton crane. This requirement will be solicited as a sole-source action to MGX Equipement Services as they are the only known authorized dealer in the state of Montana that has the capabilities to perform the complex repairs. The contractor shall perform all tasks in accordance with the saliant characteristics document and comply with all applicable local, state, and federal regulations.

A complete file of IRB actions shall be maintained for review by the Government for concurrance of classification. title: Single Award Task Order Contract (SATOC) for Mechanical / HVAC Construction Work
description: PRESOLICITATION NOTICE THIS IS A PRE-SOLICITATION NOTICE ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL. Solicitation No. AOCACB26R0058, Mechanical/ HVAC IDIQ; Architect of the Capitol Project Overview The Architect of the Capitol (AOC), Washington, DC, hereby notifies all interested offerors of its intent to issue a solicitation for a Single-Award Task Order Contract (SATOC) Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) for construction projects. Projects will include repair, alterations, and renovation services, with major work in Mechanical/HVAC, in support of the Capitol Complex facilities management. This SATOC IDIQ will have an estimated ceiling of $250,000,000 and one (1) base year with nine (9), one year optional ordering periods. The individual task orders will be negotiated and awarded as Firm-Fixed Price (FFP). This solicitation will be issued in two (2) steps. Step One of this solicitation is scheduled to be issued on or around late September 2026. Step Two of this solicitation is scheduled to be issued on/around November/December 2026. Additional details will be provided with issuance of the solicitation for Step One. The NAICS code for this procurement is 238220 - Plumbing, Heating, and Air-Conditioning Contractors. However, individual task orders issued under this IDIQ may utilize the following NAICS codes, depending on the specific work requirements: 236220 - Commercial and Institutional Building Construction 237110 � Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction 238110 � Poured Concrete Foundation and Structure Contractor 238210 � Electrical Contractors and Other Wiring Installation Contractors Project Objectives The Contractor shall be responsible for providing the necessary labor, material, equipment, incidentals, project management, supervision, quality control, transportation, insurances, taxes, coordination of tasks, and safety services under the IDIQ Contract. Task Orders issued under this contract will have major components related to MEP/HVAC, however, may not be limited to MEP/HVAC. Initial Task Order to be performed is TBD. Possible tasks orders may be for air handling and load modifications (issued as phases, i.e., Phase 1, Phase 2, etc. would each be a separate task order); recording studio ventilation; and building heating replacement. Task Orders may be concurrent or consecutive. Notice to Offerors All offerors submitting a proposal in response to the solicitation must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database prior to award of the contract. By submission of an offer, the offeror acknowledges the requirement that a prospective awardee shall be registered in the SAM database prior to award. FAR 52.204-7, System for Award Management, will be incorporated into the solicitation. For information or assistance with registering in the SAM database, log on the Internet website at https://sam.gov/. Offerors are advised that the AOC is a legislative branch entity and as such is NOT subject to the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR). However, this procurement will be solicited using a Request for Proposal (RFP) as outlined in FAR Part 15, which will result in the Best Value to the Government. Instructions to offerors and the Government�s evaluation process will be further detailed in the forthcoming solicitation. The Government intends to award one (1) contract; however, the Government reserves the right to award more than one (1) contract as a result of this solicitation. The Solicitation, and any subsequent amendments (if any), will be issued in electronic format only and will be available for download late September 2026 via SAM.gov. Further instructions on how to obtain an electronic copy of the plans and specifications will be included in the RFP. Offerors shall address any/all questions in writing to Michael Hoover, Contracting Officer, via email at michael.hoover@aoc.gov. Telephone inquiries will not be acknowledged or accepted. It is the sole responsibility of the offeror to monitor the SAM.gov website for all changes to the solicitation or for information released by the AOC. Please do not contact any other AOC personnel regarding this notification as they are not authorized to provide any information.

title: Engine Shipping Container for the General Electric F-404-103 Engine
description: 1.0 DISCLAIMER This Sources Sought Synopsis/Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for information and planning purposes�it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This RFI does not commit the Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Further, the Government is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals. Respondents are advised that the Government will not pay for any information or administrative costs incurred in response to this RFI; all costs associated with responding to this RFI will be solely at the interested party's expense. Not responding to this RFI does not preclude participation in any future RFP, if any is issued. 2.0 INTRODUCTION & BACKGROUND The T-7 Systems Program Office (SPO) is conducting market research to identify potential sources capable of manufacturing and providing peculiar packaging, specifically an engine shipping container (part number 21C11300G03), for the General Electric F-404-103 engine. The F-404-103 engine requires specialized, peculiar packaging to ensure its safe handling, transportation, and long-term storage without degradation or damage to the asset. The purpose of this notice is to gauge industry capabilities and identify qualified contractors, including small businesses, capable of meeting the requirements outlined below. 3.0 REQUIREMENT OVERVIEW The Government requires a highly durable, specialized shipping and storage container designed exclusively for the GE F-404-103 engine. The container must meet the following general characteristics and capabilities: Protection: Provide environmental and shock/vibration protection for the F-404-103 engine during intermodal transportation (air, land, and sea) and long-term storage. Compliance: Meet all applicable Military Standards (MIL-STD) for peculiar packaging, preservation, and shipping containers (MIL-STD-2073-1, MIL-STD-648). Design Characteristics: Provide secure engine mounting points, proper weight distribution, lifting and tie-down provisions, and environmental sealing (e.g., desiccant ports, humidity indicators). Durability: Constructed of materials capable of withstanding rough handling and extreme environmental conditions. Part Number: Must be the exact same as part number 21C11300G03 engine shipping container. 4.0 REQUESTED INFORMATION Interested parties are requested to submit a Capabilities Statement demonstrating their ability to fulfill this requirement. The submission should be formatted as a white paper (not to exceed 5 pages) and must include the following information: A. Company Profile Company Name and Address Point of Contact (Name, Title, Phone Number, and Email Address) CAGE Code and Unique Entity ID (UEI) Business Size and Socioeconomic Status (e.g., Small Business, 8(a), HUBZone, SDVOSB, WOSB) under the anticipated NAICS code. B. Capability & Experience A brief summary of the company's capabilities to manufacture peculiar packaging and specialized engine shipping containers. Examples of prior experience in designing, manufacturing, or overhauling specialized shipping containers of similar size, complexity, and weight (specifically for the F-404-103 engine). Include contract numbers, agency/customer names, and brief descriptions of the work performed. Provide a statement regarding the facility clearance level, if applicable. Provide information on manufacturing capacity and estimated lead times for production. C. Technical Feedback Any questions, comments, or concerns regarding the feasibility of the requirement. Identification of any potential supply chain issues or long-lead items. 5.0 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS All responses must be submitted electronically via email to the Point(s) of Contact listed below. Submissions must be received no later than 14 days from announcement, 1700 EDT on 25 September 2026. Respondents should indicate which portions of their responses are proprietary and mark accordingly, and all proprietary information must be clearly marked on the outside container and on the materials inside. The Government will handle all information properly marked as proprietary information. The Government is not liable for, or suffer any consequential damages, for any proprietary information not properly identified. Please include "Sources Sought Response: F-404-103 Engine Shipping Container - [Company Name]" in the email subject line. Proprietary information, if any, should be minimized and MUST BE CLEARLY MARKED. To aid the Government, please segregate proprietary information. 6.0 POINTS OF CONTACT Primary Point of Contact: Noah Ogle, Contract Specialist Email: noah.ogle@us.af.mil Phone: 385-680-0471 Secondary Point of Contact: Diana M. Whilding, Contracting Officer Email: diana.whilding@us.af.mil Phone: 385-636-2264

description: The Government is conducting market research to identify potential sources that possess the expertise, capabilities, and experience to meet qualification requirements to provide depot-level test and repair of the ALR-56M Power Supplies. The National Stock Numbers (NSN) and Part Numbers (PN) are as follows: Item NSN PN Power Supply, LOW VOLTAGE (PS1) 6130-01-381-3231EW 330454-104 Power Supply, LOW VOLTAGE (PS1) 6130-01-591-9810EW 330454-107 Power Supply, LOW VOLTAGE (PS2) 6130-01-408-3805EW 330454-106 Power Supply, LOW VOLTAGE (PS2) 6130-01-407-5312EW 330454-105 Power Supply, LOW VOLTAGE (PS3) 6130-01-362-0928EW 330454-103 Crane designed, tested, manufactured, and maintained custom power supply solutions including Low Voltage Power Supplies (LVPS�s), High Voltage Power Supplies (HVPS�s), and high-powered amplifiers for weapon systems aboard airborne platforms. Their power supplies are incorporated into critical Electronic Warfare (EW) systems, including the AN/ALQ-184, AN/ALR?56C, and AN/ALQ?131, demonstrating high quality and exceptional reliability to function effectively for the American and Allied Warfighter. Crane has extensive experience and know-how providing power supplies for the ALR-56M requirements. title: F/A-18E/F and EA-18G Non-Recurring Engineering (NRE) for Zn/Ni Conformal Anodes
description: The F/A-18E/F and EA-18G Program Office (PMA-265) intends to issue a firm fixed price competitive solicitation for non-recurring engineering (NRE) for F/A-18E/F and EA-18G Nose Landing Gear (NLG) and Main Landing Gear (MLG) Conformal Anodes to facilitate the transition from legacy Cadmium (CAD) plating to Low Hydrogen Embrittlement (LHE) Zinc/Nickel (Zn/Ni) plating. Under this effort, the Contractor will design, develop, fabricate, and deliver conformal anodes, associated technical drawings, and anode cases for Zn/Ni plating for the specified landing gear components. The Contractor will be responsible for performing first article inspection (FAI) in conjunction with the existing landing gear overhaul line and confirm, through current density analysis reports, adequate thickness and uniformity of Zn/Ni plating. In addition, the Contractor will also be required to provide the necessary updates to the Technical Data Package to support the transition to Zn/Ni. title: Denmark – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Udbud med forhandling af kontrakt om levering, implementering, drift, vedligeholdelse og support af økonomi- og lønsystem til Gribskov Kommune
description: Nærværende udbud vedrører indgåelse af kontrakt om Ordregivers anskaffelse af et integreret økonomi- og lønsystem med særligt fokus på sikker, stabil og effektiv drift. Kontrakten omfatter levering og implementering af løsningen samt den efterfølgende drift, vedligeholdelse og support. Under økonomidelen ligger såvel debitor, opkrævning mv., og under løndelen hører også vagtplan. Driftsydelsen udgør et centralt element i kontrakten, og omfatter det fulde ansvar for løsningens daglige drift, herunder sikring af høj tilgængelighed, performance og driftsstabilitet. description: Udbudsprocessen omfatter en kontrakt til Ordregivers anskaffelse af lovpligtig revision til hver af de fire (4) Professionshøjskoler. Den faste årlige revisionsopgave udføres til en fast tilbudt pris. Foruden den faste årlige revisionsopgave skal Tilbudsgiver levere supplerende ydelser, som løbende kan tilkøbes af Ordregiver i form af bl.a. revisionserklæringer på projekt- og tilskudsregnskaber, udvidet forvaltningsrevision samt strategisk ledelsesrådgivning og sparring, og som faktureres i henhold til tilbudte timepriser. Udbuddet er opdelt i fire (4) delaftaler for hhv. hver Professionshøjskole: • Delaftale 1 – Lovpligtig revision til UCL Erhvervsakademi & Professionshøjskole (UCL) • Delaftale 2 – Lovpligtig revision til Professionshøjskolen University College Nordjylland (UCN) • Delaftale 3 – Lovpligtig revision til University College Syddanmark (UC Syd) • Delaftale 4 – Lovpligtig revision til Professionshøjskolen VIA University College (VIA UC) Der kan afgives tilbud på en eller flere de udbudte delaftaler. Der skal afleveres et (1) tilbud pr. delaftale, som Tilbudsgiver ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Revisionsopgavens omfang er afhængigt af en række forhold, herunder kompleksitet mv. Der henvises i øvrigt til udbudsmaterialet for nærmere beskrivelse af, hvilke ydelser der er indeholdt i den samlede revisionsopgave.

title: Denmark – Construction work – FAB afd. 12, Mosegårdsparken - Hovedentrepriseudbud
description: Disse udbudsbetingelser gælder for realisering af Fyns Almennyttige Boligselskab afd. 12, Mosegården med støtte fra Landsbyggefonden. Udbuddet gennemføres som et begrænset udbud med forudgående prækvalifikation efter udbudslovens § 58-60. Det er således kun de virksomheder, der bliver prækvalificeret af Ordregiver, der vil blive opfordret til at afgive tilbud. Denne opfordring til at afgive tilbud omfatter udelukkende det i disse udbudsbetingelser nævnte bygge- og anlægsarbejde. Fyns Almennyttige Boligselskab er et alment boligselskab underlagt det lovgrundlag og regelsæt, der gælder for almene boligorganisationer. Ordregiver gør opmærksom på, at samtlige projektdokumenter, som fremgår af den fælles dokumentfortegnelse, er en del af udbudsmaterialet. Tilbudsgiver er pligtig til at kontrollere at denne har adgang til det fulde projektmateriale. Tilbudsgiver opfordres til at læse det samlede udbudsmateriale grundigt igennem, da det indeholder de nødvendige informationer for tilbudsafgivelse. Udbudsmaterialet består endvidere af spørgsmål og svar samt eventuelle rettelsesblade, som løbende bliver offentliggjort på udbudsportalen i anonymiseret form. Det udbudte omfatter bygge- og anlægsarbejder i hovedentreprise vedrørende renovering af helhedsplaner for Afd. 12 - Mosegårdsparken Primulavej 1-73, Lathyrusvej 1-89, Monbergsvej 51-59 5000 Odense C. Ordregiver forventer, at kontrakten vil blive indgået i henhold til tidsplanen. Begrundelsen for varigheden af perioden mellem tildelingsbeslutningen og kontraktindgåelsen er ansøgningsprocessen for ydelsesstøtte til renoveringsprojekter, der tildeles af Landsbyggefonden. I perioden mellem tildelingsbeslutning og kontraktindgåelse ansøger Ordregiver herom. Den vindende tilbudsgiver er forpligtet til at bistå Ordregiver med eventuelle oplysninger, såfremt Ordregiver anmoder herom. Der indgås kontrakt med én hovedentreprenør. Som en del af projektmaterialet indgår grundlag for entreprisekontrakt. Det er udelukkende hovedentreprenøren der skal leve op til mindstekravene. Udelukkelsesgrunde: Ordregiver vil udelukke ansøgere der er omfattet af: • De obligatoriske udelukkelsesgrunde i udbudslovens §§ 135, stk. 1-3 og 136. • De frivillige udelukkelsesgrunde i udbudslovens § 137, stk. 1, nr. 1-6. Såfremt en ansøger er omfattet af de obligatoriske eller frivillige udelukkelses-grunde i udbudslovens §§ 135-136 samt 137, stk. 1, nr. 1-6, kan ansøger ved at fremlægge tilstrækkelig dokumentation for sin pålidelighed påvise, at denne alligevel ikke skal udelukkes, jf. betingelserne i udbudslovens § 138. Ordregiver vil i tilfælde af, at den påtænker at udelukke en ansøger, fastsætte en passende frist for fremlæggelse af tilstrækkelig dokumentation for ansøgerens pålidelighed. Rådets forordning (EU) 2022/576 Der kan ikke tildeles kontrakt til følgende virksomheder, jf. Rådets forordning (EU) 2022/576 af 8. April 2022 om ændring af forordning (EU) nr. 833/2014 om restriktive foranstaltninger på baggrund af Ruslands handlinger, der destabiliserer situationen i Ukraine: A. russiske statsborgere eller fysiske eller juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, der er etableret i Rusland B. juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, hvoraf en enhed som omhandlet i nærværende stykkes litra a) direkte eller indirekte ejer over 50 %, eller C. fysiske eller juridiske personer, enheder eller organer, der handler på vegne af eller efter anvisning fra en enhed som omhandlet i nærværende stykkes litra a) eller b), Ligeledes kan der ikke anvendes underleverandører eller støttende enheder, der er omfattet af ovenstående, hvis denne aktørs bidrag udgør mere end 10 % af kontraktværdien. Ordregiver har til hensigt at prækvalificere 5 ansøgere, som vil blive opfordret til at afgive tilbud. Hvis flere end 5 ansøgere opfylder Ordregivers krav til egnethed, udvælger Ordre-giver de 5 ansøgere, der samlet set har dokumenteret den mest relevante og sammenlignelige erfaring i forhold til den udbudte opgave. Ved udvælgelsen lægges der vægt på følgende: • Referencernes relevans i forhold til nærværende projekt, herunder renoveringsomfang, opgavetype og kompleksitet. • Erfaring med hovedentrepriser af sammenlignelig størrelse og kompleksitet. • Erfaring med renoveringsopgaver for almene boligorganisationer. • Erfaring med genhusning, beboerkontakt og arbejder i beboede boliger. • Ansøgers konkrete rolle og ansvar i referenceprojektet. • Referencernes økonomiske størrelse. Referencer med en entreprisesum på minimum 100 mio. kr. ekskl. moms tillægges positiv vægt. Referencer med en entreprisesum på minimum 150 mio. kr. ekskl. moms tillægges særlig positiv vægt. Ved udvælgelsen foretager Ordregiver en samlet vurdering af de afleverede referencers relevans og sammenlignelighed.

title: Italy – Drinks dispensers – Noleggio full service di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali della Rai di Roma, Milano e Sedi Regionali
description: La presente procedura è finalizzata all’affidamento di un Contratto avente ad oggetto il noleggio “full service”, articolato in n. 2 lotti, di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali della Rai di Roma, Milano e Sedi Regionali. Ai sensi dell’art. 58 del Codice, la procedura è articolata nei seguenti n. 2 lotti, il cui perimetro è stato definito sulla base di distinti criteri infra dettagliati: Noleggio “full service” di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali Rai di Roma e Milano Noleggio “full service” di erogatori di acqua potabile presso gli insediamenti aziendali Rai delle Sedi Regionali. Tenuto conto dei principi in materia, il perimetro di ciascun lotto è stato definito applicando un criterio geografico per un bilanciamento tra obiettivi diversi: mantenere una logica di continuità territoriale per la preminente esigenza connessa ad un efficiente gestione della prestazione contrattuale e, al contempo, consentire la partecipazione alle microimprese, piccole e medie imprese (MPMI) in grado di modulare la propria offerta in relazione a potenziali specificità territoriali. In riferimento al Lotto n. 2 delle Sedi Regionali, si è ritenuto di non suddividere ulteriormente i diversi cespiti al fine di conseguire il raggiungimento di elevate economie di scala generate dall’aggregazione della domanda. Il Servizio dovrà svolgersi in esecuzione delle prescrizioni contenute nel Capitolato tecnico nonché di tutti gli ulteriori documenti di gara, tenendo conto, inoltre, di quanto previsto dalla normativa vigente in materia in conformità al Cap. 5 dei Criteri Ambientali Minimi (“CAM”) relativi ai servizi di ristoro e alla distribuzione di acqua di rete a fini potabili, di cui al decreto 6 novembre 2023, adottati con Decreto del Ministero dell’ambiente e della sicurezza energetica del 9 aprile 2025, pubblicati sulla Gazzetta Ufficiale serie generale n. 96 del 26/04/2025. In particolare, l'oggetto dell'appalto consiste nel noleggio full service di erogatori di acqua potabile presso le sedi Rai interessate dall'iniziativa, come infra specificate, secondo le quantità indicate nella Parte 3a Elenco delle apparecchiature del Capitolato Tecnico. Il noleggio comprende, oltre alla messa a disposizione delle apparecchiature, le seguenti attività accessorie e strumentali, il cui valore economico complessivamente considerato è stimato in misura inferiore al 12% dell'importo posto a base di gara per ciascun lotto: a) installazione degli erogatori, comprensiva dei collegamenti elettrici e idrici (adduzione e scarico) ai punti predisposti dalla Rai da completarsi entro 15 giorni lavorativi dall’avvio del Contratto; b) manutenzione completa ordinaria e correttiva delle apparecchiature, comprensiva delle verifiche, controlli e revisioni periodiche (cfr. “Parte 2° Programma di manutenzione periodica” del Capitolato Tecnico), delle attività di sanificazione, della sostituzione dei materiali di consumo e delle parti soggette ad usura, nonché di ogni ulteriore intervento necessario ad assicurarne il corretto funzionamento in conformità a quanto previsto anche dai documenti di manutenzione rilasciati dal costruttore degli erogatori, da eseguirsi in ottemperanza alle vigenti normative; c) esecuzione delle analisi periodiche delle acque previste dal Capitolato Tecnico; d) garanzia, assistenza tecnica, movimentazione delle apparecchiature e sostituzione integrale degli erogatori nei casi previsti dal Capitolato Tecnico ed, in particolare, per eventuali spostamenti degli erogatori in altri punti dello stesso cespite e/o di altri cespiti su espressa richiesta della Rai; e) interventi di miglioramento, adeguamento o sostituzione degli erogatori che risultino necessari per dare attuazione a modifiche normative o a specifiche richieste da parte delle autorità competenti; f) disinstallazione, spostamento, rimozione e ritiro degli erogatori al termine del contratto (o nel corso di svolgimento del Servizio quando necessario come da Capitolato) e contestuale ripristino degli spazi in status quo ante. Tali attività sono remunerate unitariamente mediante il canone contrattuale e non costituiscono autonome prestazioni principali. La fornitura si intende comprensiva delle certificazioni previste dal Capitolato e della documentazione tecnica attestante con chiarezza le modalità di utilizzazione, le specifiche tecniche, le modalità di installazione e le istruzioni di manutenzione nonché la conformità alla normativa europea vigente. Ogni prodotto deve essere corredato, ove presente, dalle relative istruzioni in lingua italiana per consentire un uso corretto ed in condizioni di sicurezza dello stesso e dalla garanzia del produttore. L’Appaltatore è, pertanto, tenuto, a propria cura e spese, e con propria organizzazione ed attrezzatura, a porre in atto tutti gli interventi e le verifiche che le leggi impongono, i controlli, e quant’altro necessario, anche se non esplicitamente specificato, per il mantenimento in perfetta efficienza degli erogatori di acqua potabile oggetto dell’Appalto, assumendosene tutti gli oneri e le responsabilità secondo i termini e le condizioni previsti dal Capitolato Tecnico. Non sono previsti limiti di partecipazione ai lotti e/o di aggiudicazione dei lotti nei confronti del medesimo operatore economico.

title: Denmark – Construction work – GENERISK IV SAMT DOMICILER – TAULOV DRY PORT A/S
description: Ved nærværende udbud ønsker Ordregiver at indhente tilbud på projektering og udførelse af ”Generisk VI samt domiciler”, der er et lager- og logistikcenter som Taulov Dryport A/S opfører i området ved Hertugens Kvarter i Taulov. Her er det Ordregivers ønske at udvikle en dynamisk, kvalitetsstærk og fremtidsparat bebyggelse, der afspejler og understøtter udviklingen af Taulov Dryport som Danmarks førende knudepunkt for transport og logistik. Nærværende dokument indeholder betingelser og vejledning om afgivelse af ansøgning og tilbud på denne opgave. Ordregivers krav til kontraktvilkår fremgår af udbudsmaterialets udkast til totalentreprisekontrakt, mens kravene til ydelsen er detaljeret beskrevet i udbudsmaterialet, herunder byggeprogram inkl. bilag. Udbuddet gennemføres i overensstemmelse med Forsyningsvirksomhedsdirektivet, DIREKTIV 2014/25/EU af 26. februar 2014. Udbuddet omfatter en option, der vedrører indretning af mezzaniner. Udbuddet omfatter en option, der vedrører udførelse af 2 stk. kontorbygninger. Optionen er nærmere beskrevet i Udkast til kontrakt pkt. 1.03 og i byggeprogrammet bilag 2.02. Udbuddet gennemføres som et udbud med forhandling, og forløber i tre faser; en prækvalifikationsfase hvor egnede virksomheder udvælges til at deltage i udbuddet, en indledende tilbudsfase og en forhandlingsfase med efterfølgende afgivelse af endeligt tilbud. Tilbudsgiver gøres opmærksom på, at der, inden for rammerne af de gældende udbudsregler, kan foretages ændringer af udbudsmaterialet efter offentliggørelse af dette, herunder ændringer af byggeprogrammet og udbudsbetingelserne. Tilbudsgiver opfordres derfor til løbende at holde sig orienteret om udbuddet.

title: Netherlands – Road-maintenance works – Raamovereenkomst dagelijks en groot onderhoud elementenverhardingen en straatmeubilair 2027-2028
description: Aanbestedende dienst heeft tot doel een aannemer te contracteren die zorg draagt voor vakkundig onderhoud van alle elementenverhardingen die in het beheer zijn van de gemeente Gouda. Daarnaast maakt het leveren van een aantal andere diensten, zoals het inrichten en in stand houden van een wachtdienst, het verzorgen van onderhoud aan straatmeubilair en het afwikkelen van meldingen onderdeel uit van het af te sluiten contract. Hierbij is het de insteek van de gemeente om zoveel mogelijk de werkzaamheden over te laten aan de Opdrachtnemer, waarbij een goede balans tussen het ontzorgen van en het houden van regie door de gemeente het streven is. De aan te besteden Opdracht bestaat uit het uitvoeren van dagelijks en groot onderhoud aan elementen- en halfverhardingen en straatmeubilair binnen de gemeente Gouda, waaronder in ieder geval: • Spoedherstel n.a.v. spoedmeldingen; • Planbaar herstel n.a.v. meldingen; • Grondwerk t.b.v. onderhoudswerkzaamheden; • Leidingwerk t.b.v. onderhoudswerkzaamheden; • Dagelijks onderhoud elementen- en halfverhardingen (< 200 m2 per tracé/wegvak); • Groot onderhoud elementen- en halfverhardingen (> 200 m2 per tracé/wegvak); • Kleine aanpassingen, veranderingen en reconstructies openbare ruimte; • Herstel en incidentele vervanging van straatmeubilair en wegbebakening; • Opstellen verkeersmaatregelenplannen t.b.v. uitvoeringswerkzaamheden; • Toepassen maatregelen t.b.v. waarborgen bereikbaarheid. Daarnaast maakt het verzorgen van een wachtdienst, het afwikkelen van meldingen en het verzorgen van de benodigde vergunningen voor eigen werk onderdeel uit van de Opdracht. Het te onderhouden areaal verhardingen bedraagt circa 1,8 miljoen m2 elementenverhardingen en circa 52.000 m2 halfverharde wegen.

title: Germany – Engineering services – MPI für Geoanthropologie, Jena - Umbau und Generalsanierung zum Institutsgebäude von zwei denkmalgeschützten Klinikgebäuden - Fachplanung Technische Ausrüstung (Labor)
description: Der Leistungsumfang betrifft die umfangreiche Generalsanierung von zwei denkmalgeschützten Bestandsgebäuden (ehemalige Kliniken) mit Planung und Umbau zu neuen Verwaltungs- und Laborräumen für das Max-Planck-Institut für Geoanthropologie in Jena. Auf dem Flurstück 105 / Lessingstraße 1 befindet sich die ehemalige Urologie mit einem denkmalgeschützten Teil aus dem Jahr 1914 und einem Anbau aus dem Jahr 1991. Auf dem Flurstück 102/5 / Lessingstraße 2 befindet sich die ehemalige HNO aus dem Baujahr 1928. Die Gebäude sind jeweils 4-geschossig mit zusätzlichem teilbelichtetem Kellergeschoss sowie nicht ausgebautem Giebelgeschoss. Gebäude und Gartenanlage stehen unter Denkmalschutz; daher ist eine enge Abstimmung mit dem Landesamt für Denkmalpflege bzw. der unteren Denkmalschutzbehörde erforderlich. Das Institutsgebäude wird überwiegend aus Büroflächen und Büronebenflächen bestehen. Weiterhin sind Seminarräume, ein Laborbereich mit Lagerflächen, Serverräume und ein Decision Theatre vorgesehen. Der Laborbereich wird als gemeinsam genutzter Laborpool für alle experimentell arbeitenden Organisationseinheiten ausgebildet. Der hochinstallierte Experimentalbereich mit Laboren, Laborlagern und Servern soll im Anbau der ehemaligen Urologie untergebracht werden. Die niedrig installierten Büro- und Kommunikationsflächen werden im denkmalgeschützten Teil der Urologie sowie in der HNO untergebracht. Gegenstand dieses VgV-Vergabeverfahrens sind die Leistungen der Fachplanung Technische Ausrüstung (Medizin- oder labortechnische Anlagen) gemäß § 55 HOAI in Verbindung mit Anlage 15 zur HOAI 2021 für die Anlagengruppe 7 in den Leistungsphasen 2, 3 und 5 bis 9 sowie die im Vertrag und in dessen Anlage A beschriebenen Besonderen Leistungen. Das Projekt wird als BIM-Projekt im Open-BIM-Verfahren durchgeführt. Bestandteil des Auftrags sind außerdem die in den Vertragsunterlagen einschließlich Leistungsbild beschriebenen BIM-bezogenen Leistungen, Koordinationsleistungen sowie die Erstellung, Fortschreibung und Bereitstellung der Fachmodelle nach den vertraglichen Vorgaben. Weitere Angaben zur Ausgangssituation, Aufgabenstellung und zum Leistungsumfang ergeben sich aus Anlage 01 sowie aus dem Ingenieurvertrag Labor einschließlich Leistungsbild. Besonderer Hinweis betr. Bieterfragen aufgrund besonderer äußerer Ereignisse (z.B. Sars-COV-2 oder Ukraine Krieg): Bitte berücksichtigen Sie bei Ihrer Angebotserstellung etwaige mögliche bzw. erkennbare Beeinträchtigungen, z.B. in Bezug auf die Verfügbarkeit von Materialien und Produkten, Arbeitskräften, eine evtl. verzögerte Beibringung von geforderten Nachweisen, Auswirkungen auf etwaige Nachunternehmer etc. Fragen, die in diesem Zusammenhang auftreten, bitten wir rechtzeitig vor Angebotsfrist über das Nachrichtensystem der eVergabe zu stellen.

Alle öffentlichen Straßen, Gehwege sowie Parkräume sind freizuhalten. buyer: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Internationale Zusammenarbeit (GIZ) GmbH
title: Germany – Research and development consultancy services – 10030774-Providing Technical Assistance on Industrial Decarbonisation, CBAM Readiness, Gender Inclusion, Pilot and Upscaling
description: India's industrial sector plays a central role in the country's economic growth, while also contributing significantly to energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions. As India advances its climate ambitions, including the target of achieving net-zero emissions by 2070, industrial decarbonisation and energy efficiency have become key priorities for enabling a sustainable and inclusive transition. In this context, the Indo-German bilateral cooperation between the German Federal Ministry for Economic Cooperation and Development (BMZ) and the Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE), implemented by GIZ, supports industrial decarbonisation through energy efficiency measures. Acting as a service provider and implementing agency for German international cooperation for sustainable development, GIZ works with Indian and German partners on project implementation and delivering effective solutions that contribute to sustainable transformation. The cooperation between the German side and BEE builds on a long-standing partnership in the field of energy efficiency and industrial transformation. Over the years, the collaboration has continuously supported the implementation of the Energy Conservation Act and contributed to a range of initiatives targeting both large industries and Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs). While significant progress has been achieved, considerable untapped potential for industrial energy efficiency and decarbonisation remains, underlining the need for strengthened policy frameworks, innovative market instruments, and scaled implementation approaches. Against this background, the project "Energy Efficiency" supports industrial decarbonisation through four key intervention areas: (a) developing strategies for industrial decarbonisation, including in the context of the Indian Carbon Market; (b) supporting the design and implementation of incentive schemes such as ADEETIE; (c) promoting industrial energy efficiency measures through demonstration projects and awareness campaigns; and (d) advancing gender equality and social inclusion in the industrial transition. Through these interventions, the project aims to strengthen policy frameworks, market mechanisms, institutional capacities, and inclusive approaches for a sustainable industrial transformation.

Damit die Bildungsakademie der GeNo auch in Zukunft den steigenden Anforderungen in Aus-, Fort- und Weiterbildungen im Gesundheitssektor gerecht werden kann, hat der Senat Bremens eine zentrale Standortlösung für die Bildungsakademie der Gesundheit Nord beschlossen. Die Bildungsakademie muss in den kommenden Jahren im Rahmen der Entwicklung des Neuen Hulsberg-Viertels (NHV) neu verortet werden. Die Bildungsakademie soll zukünftig dauerhaft in Haus 7 (denkmalgeschütztes Gebäude auf dem Klinikgelände des KBM) und einem ergänzenden Neubau östlich des geplanten Klinikparkhauses im NHV verortet werden. Ein privater Investor soll sowohl die Bauherrenfunktion als auch die vollständige Finanzierung des Projekts übernehmen. Uppdraget innefattar ett helhetsåtagande för Tjänsten, vilket omfattar det systemstöd som utgör en del av Tjänsten samt tillhörande tjänster som krävs för att Tjänsten ska kunna införas, användas och fungera över tid. Option 2 Administrera hanteringen av utläggskvitton och stödja utbetalning av ersättning från Kommunen till medarbetaren för köp av friskvårdstjänst av i Tjänsten anslutna friskvårdsleverantörer. (frivillig) Pris för Option 2 ingår inte i utvärderingen av anbuden. Kommunen äger rätt, men inte skyldighet, att under avtalstiden nyttja denna option. Om Leverantören kan tillhandahålla denna funktionalitet lämnas pris för Option 2 i Bilaga Prisblad. Option 3 Förmånscyklar (frivillig) Optionen avser att Leverantören genom Tjänsten ska kunna erbjuda stöd för administration och hantering av förmånscyklar för Kommunens anställda för privat bruk. Lösningen får tillhandahållas genom tredjepartsleverantör ansluten till Tjänsten. Kommunen har i dagsläget inte fattat beslut om införande av förmånscyklar och några krav avseende sådan funktionalitet ställs därför inte inom ramen för denna upphandling. Optionen omfattas inte av utvärderingen och Anbudsgivaren ska därför inte lämna något pris för optionen. Kommunen avgör ensidigt om, när och i vilken omfattning optionen ska nyttjas under avtalstiden. Kommunen förbehåller sig rätten att avstå från att nyttja optionen samt att, helt eller delvis, anskaffa motsvarande tjänst eller funktionalitet genom separat upphandling.

title: Radiation Testing
description: NASA/Goddard Space Flight Center (GSFC) has a requirement for engineering services and support to conduct ground-based accelerated radiation testing of microelectronic and photonic elements. NASA conducts evaluations of candidate electrical, electronic, and electromechanical (EEE) parts for use in spacecraft and spaceflight instruments. The specified analysis procedures sometimes require ground-based accelerated radiation testing, necessitating the use of particle accelerators to emulate the space environment. These ground-based tests use particle accelerators to provide ion beams that can be employed to evaluate single-event effects (SEE), total ionizing dose (TID), and displacement damage dose (DDD). Understanding these effects is critical for mission success. The period of performance is anticipated to be up to five (5) years from the date of award. NASA/GSFC intends to issue a sole source blanket purchase agreement (BPA) and calls placed against the BPA in accordance with FAR Part 12.201-1(e)(3) to acquire these services from the Cyclotron Institute at Texas A&M University (TAMU) under the statutory authority of 41 U.S.C. 1901, Simplified acquisition procedures. TAMU is the only known facility that can provide the necessary tuned beam energies of 15, 25, and 40 MeV/u, uniform particle fluxes up to 1e5/(cm2.s), an in-air testing/positioning system, and the required ease of access. The Government intends to acquire a commercial product or service using FAR Part 12. Interested organizations may submit their capabilities and qualifications to perform the effort electronically via email to Stephanie Stephens at stephanie.d.stephens@nasa.gov and Jason Lou at jason.d.lou@nasa.gov not later than 6:00pm EST on September 25, 2026. Such capabilities/qualifications will be evaluated solely for the purpose of determining whether to conduct this acquisition on a competitive basis. A decision by the Government not to compete this acquisition on a full and open competition basis, based upon responses to this notice, is solely within the discretion of the Government. NASA Clause 1852.215-84, Ombudsman, is applicable. The Center Ombudsman for this acquisition can be found at: https://www.hq.nasa.gov/office/procurement/regs/Procurement-Ombuds-Comp-Advocate-Listing.pdf

title: Modular Power Generation and Distribution
description: Other Transactional Authority Request for White PapersModular Power Generation and Distribution: The Department of Defense has an urgent, unmet requirement for relocatable Modular Power Generation and Distribution solutions. These systems are unique that must be capable of supplying and stabilizing large transient loads that are typically problematic for traditional power generation solutions. A solution is required at various locations across the 50 United States. Current operational sites lack the foundational power generation and distribution architecture necessary to support modern, power-intensive mission equipment. There is a critical need for these solutions to be implemented no later than 28 February 2028 to meet additional mission objectives. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Huntsville Center (CEHNC) has an ongoing mission to support requirements across the Department of War (DoW). CEHNC has been tasked to provide all manufacturing, procurement, shipping, delivery, installation, and testing of Modular Power Generation and Distribution Solutions for 10-12 sites in the 50 United States.

title: LD5 Anchor Bar Refurbishment
description: This procurement is for the refurbishment of eight (8) used Government owned anchor bars assemblies recently removed from Lock and Dam 9. The anchor bar assemblies range in age from 30-90 years old, are in poor physical condition, and feature seized components due to a historic lack of articulation and lubrication. The contractor shall disassemble the anchor bar assemblies (as matched sets), clean/degrease all surfaces, perform non-destructive testing (NDT), inspect all components, blast/paint exposed surfaces, apply anti-corrosive treatments, and reassemble the units to tolerances.

title: Base Notice: Space Systems Command (SSC) Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR) Research and Development (R&D) Effort.
description: Sources Sought for Space Systems Command (SSC) Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR) Research and Development (R&D) Effort. The United States Space Force, Space Systems Command (SSC) Wide Field of View (WFOV) Program Office, Boulder Ground Innovation Facility, Colorado intends to sole source this requirement to L3-Harris, but is seeking vendors that may be able to perform this requirement in order to support a competitive procurement for relevant technology developments to continue the calibration and characterization efforts for the Wide Field Of View (WFOV) Testbed Wide-Area Six Degree Payload (WASP). This request is an element of ongoing market research to define potential solutions to support Department of Defense (DoD) and National Overhead Persistent Infrared (OPIR) initiatives. Information received in response to this RFI will be used to determine an appropriate acquisition strategy. The following paragraphs outline the current and desired capabilities that shall be provided in support of on-orbit support to the WFOV Testbed OPIR R&D effort: Offeror shall accomplish program objectives and meet near-term program milestones. Offerors must be familiar with the design, operation, calibration, and performance (optical and thermal) of a specific proprietary wide-field-of-view staring OPIR refractive telescope designed and manufactured by L3 Technologies. The Payload includes a custom focal plane array (FPA) from L3-Cincinnati Electronics (CE) that is cooled by a cryocooler. The Offeror must be familiar with custom electronics boxes and interfaces, including FPA electronics, cryocooler electronics, and main electronics boxes (and their respective custom software). The electronic boxes include FPGAs that pass mission data over a high-speed interface, and are mounted within a Millennium Space Systems (MSS) spacecraft that will fly in geostationary orbit with a Ka-band downlink. The Offeror must operate facilities at and employ personnel cleared with Secret and up to TS/SCI, if needed. Response from small and small disadvantaged businesses is encouraged. The size standard for NAICS 541715 is 1,000 employees. Anticipated contract award date 1QFY27. Statement of Capabilities 1. title: Kronos Family of Systems Commercial Solutions Opening
description: SUBJECT: AOI 3 Space Intelligence � Third Call for Submissions Under the Notice ID FA8806-26-S-0001 (01 July 2026) Kronos Family of Systems (FoS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) 1. Purpose: This document constitutes the Third Call under the Kronos FoS CSO. Refer to the Kronos FoS CSO 2.0 for all administrative, legal, and overarching procedures. 2. This Call specifically requests Phase 1A (Quad Chart and White Paper) submissions to address Area of Interest (AOI) 3, and its Focus Area Statements (FAS) detailed below. 3. FAS #1 (AOI 03-FAS01): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks an enterprise collection management orchestration capability to coherently link existing sensor optimization and scheduling capabilities for sensing of the space domain. The capability focuses on the optimal use of finite sensors to meet collection requirements that fulfill positional tracking, operational intelligence, and foundational intelligence needs. This effort will focus not only on USSF sensors but also establish interfaces with other DoW, Intelligence Community (IC), allied, and commercial assets. A successful orchestration �brain� must demonstrate the ability to integrate multiple orchestration engines utilizing distinct scheduling paradigms (e.g., pre-planned, dynamic tip-and-cue event response, automated metric optimization), rapidly adjudicate scheduling conflicts when dynamic tasks out-prioritize deliberate needs, and disseminate commander decisions to sensors, sensor brokers, and external orchestration platforms. The capability shall consider weather, planned and unplanned outages, multiple sensor phenomenologies, tasking acknowledgment response times, PED and correlation timelines, competing prioritization schemes, and the ability to monitor execution during dynamic events. Furthermore, the proposed solution must deliver intuitive user feedback regarding collection requirement satisfaction (with full traceability), candidate rescheduling options for human review, human-in-the-loop intervention, and transparent performance metrics. A successful solution shall provide a rapid path for a prototype to host on Secret and Top Secret domains to interface with existing tasking engines and sensors. 4. FAS #2 (AOI 03-FAS02): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks innovative commercial solutions and products addressing the ability to ingest and analyze radar and sensor data for characterization of on-orbit assets. Capability should allow support analysis of radar cross sections, object discrimination and velocity and maneuver determination. 5. FAS #3 (AOI 03-FAS03): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks innovative commercial solutions and products addressing novel or innovative ways to ingest and analyze commercial RF data and distribution of data to operations centers to support object maneuver detection, status assessments, and object identification efforts. 6. FAS #4 (AOI 03-FAS04): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks innovative commercial solutions and products addressing deployment of capabilities to the tactical edge, using novel or innovative methodologies to transport data back to operations centers. Solutions should demonstrate the ability to operate through disconnected connectivity and demonstrate re-sync of data once re-connected. 7. FAS #5 (AOI 3-FAS05): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program and its stakeholders seek innovative commercial solutions and products which enable immediate reporting of space events to the U.S. Space Command Joint Operations Center. This capability will collate all event knowledge as it�s occurring to provide Combatant Commanders, Joint Staff, and National Leadership situational awareness, real-time updates, and response options for approval. The system must be able to support both coalition space event conferences and U.S. -only space event conferences. 8. Offerors may submit more than one white paper and quad chart for this call and any future call. The white paper and quad chart proposed prototype solution may address one or more focus areas; but it must be clear in the proposed solution how the proposed prototype addresses the AOI and which focus areas. 9. Submission Timeline: Questions regarding this Call shall be submitted no later than 1200 Pacific Time on 09 September 2026. Phase 1A submissions (Quad Chart and White Paper) shall be received no later than 1700 Pacific Time on 25 September 2026. 10. Additional Information: All submission instructions, eligibility requirements, evaluation procedures, and applicable terms and conditions are contained within the Kronos FoS CSO. Offerors are responsible for monitoring SAM.gov (http://sam.gov) for amendments, answers to questions, and any updates associated with this Call.

description: SUBJECT: AOI 3 Space Intelligence � Third Call for Submissions Under the Notice ID FA8806-26-S-0001 (01 July 2026) Kronos Family of Systems (FoS) Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) 1. Purpose: This document constitutes the Third Call under the Kronos FoS CSO. Refer to the Kronos FoS CSO 2.0 for all administrative, legal, and overarching procedures. 2. This Call specifically requests Phase 1A (Quad Chart and White Paper) submissions to address Area of Interest (AOI) 3, and its Focus Area Statements (FAS) detailed below. 3. FAS #1 (AOI 03-FAS01): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks an enterprise collection management orchestration capability to coherently link existing sensor optimization and scheduling capabilities for sensing of the space domain. The capability focuses on the optimal use of finite sensors to meet collection requirements that fulfill positional tracking, operational intelligence, and foundational intelligence needs. This effort will focus not only on USSF sensors but also establish interfaces with other DoW, Intelligence Community (IC), allied, and commercial assets. A successful orchestration �brain� must demonstrate the ability to integrate multiple orchestration engines utilizing distinct scheduling paradigms (e.g., pre-planned, dynamic tip-and-cue event response, automated metric optimization), rapidly adjudicate scheduling conflicts when dynamic tasks out-prioritize deliberate needs, and disseminate commander decisions to sensors, sensor brokers, and external orchestration platforms. The capability shall consider weather, planned and unplanned outages, multiple sensor phenomenologies, tasking acknowledgment response times, PED and correlation timelines, competing prioritization schemes, and the ability to monitor execution during dynamic events. Furthermore, the proposed solution must deliver intuitive user feedback regarding collection requirement satisfaction (with full traceability), candidate rescheduling options for human review, human-in-the-loop intervention, and transparent performance metrics. A successful solution shall provide a rapid path for a prototype to host on Secret and Top Secret domains to interface with existing tasking engines and sensors. 4. FAS #2 (AOI 03-FAS02): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks innovative commercial solutions and products addressing the ability to ingest and analyze radar and sensor data for characterization of on-orbit assets. Capability should allow support analysis of radar cross sections, object discrimination and velocity and maneuver determination. 5. FAS #3 (AOI 03-FAS03): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks innovative commercial solutions and products addressing novel or innovative ways to ingest and analyze commercial RF data and distribution of data to operations centers to support object maneuver detection, status assessments, and object identification efforts. 6. FAS #4 (AOI 03-FAS04): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program seeks innovative commercial solutions and products addressing deployment of capabilities to the tactical edge, using novel or innovative methodologies to transport data back to operations centers. Solutions should demonstrate the ability to operate through disconnected connectivity and demonstrate re-sync of data once re-connected. 7. FAS #5 (AOI 3-FAS05): The SSC SYD 85 Kronos Program and its stakeholders seek innovative commercial solutions and products which enable immediate reporting of space events to the U.S. Space Command Joint Operations Center. This capability will collate all event knowledge as it�s occurring to provide Combatant Commanders, Joint Staff, and National Leadership situational awareness, real-time updates, and response options for approval. The system must be able to support both coalition space event conferences and U.S. -only space event conferences. 8. Offerors may submit more than one white paper and quad chart for this call and any future call. The white paper and quad chart proposed prototype solution may address one or more focus areas; but it must be clear in the proposed solution how the proposed prototype addresses the AOI and which focus areas. 9. Submission Timeline: Questions regarding this Call shall be submitted no later than 1200 Pacific Time on 09 September 2026. Phase 1A submissions (Quad Chart and White Paper) shall be received no later than 1700 Pacific Time on 25 September 2026. 10. Additional Information: All submission instructions, eligibility requirements, evaluation procedures, and applicable terms and conditions are contained within the Kronos FoS CSO. Offerors are responsible for monitoring SAM.gov (http://sam.gov) for amendments, answers to questions, and any updates associated with this Call. 11.
